description: Lo-fi radio/megaphone effect on a dedicated LoFi track. Narrow mid band plus grit; blend against the clean part.
name: lofi-radio
notes: Precondition: duplicate the part onto a LoFi track; EQ slot 0, distortion slot 1. Select LoFi before sending.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved titles; try Drive/Tone if Boost is not found.
Plugin mismatch names the actual insert plugins; adjust the plugin fields and resend.
Low/high cuts are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
